notes.title: NEW UPDATE: NEW DESERT MAP
notes.notes:
[NEW MAP ]
Hi Managers, are you ready to take on another managing adventure?
This update features a brand new desert map, take all your experience and dive in this new world.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 08/31/2024
notes.notes:
[ FIXES ]


 Bus takes long time to pickup people.
 Fix vehicles rotation when game starts.
 AI stuck and navigation.
 Mouse wheel alternative (you can rotate using left/right arrows).
 Big storage shelf tags editing.
 Products placed in the ground next to shelves.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 08/30/2024
notes.notes:
[ FIXES ]


 Mark room for housekeeping resets after loading the game.
 Employee individual assignment: only tagged shelves deleted (had no effect on the game, instead use the global only tagged shelves).
 Stairs collision and navigation blocking AI.
 Shelves tagging widget not showing all the tags.
 Guest stuck at room and showing a lot of time to wait.
 Some interaction problems (ex: can't take plugs ou the wall).
 Game freezing sometimes.
